name: Sikalastic-8902
paste:
SIKALASTIC®-8902: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-8902, April 2023, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sikalastic-8902.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-8902 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description. Sikalastic®-8902 is a 2-part, polyurethane, transparent tack coat for Sikalastic®-827 HT hot melt pellets
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikalastic®-8902 may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Bonding Sikalastic®-827 HT hot melt pellets on Sikalastic®-851 and Sikalastic®-8800 waterproofing membranes
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-8902
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Polyurethane tack coat for Sikalastic®-827 HT hot melt pellets
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - HAPAS Certificate, Sikalastic®-851-8902-827, BBA, Certificate No.15/H237
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - DIN 53504: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Easy to apply
    - Applied by brush, roller or airless spray
    - Heat resistant to mastic asphalt application
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyurethane
    - Density: ~1,39 kg/l (mixed resin, at +23 °C)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tensile strength: >10 N/m² (DIN 53504)
2.7 Temperature resistance.
    | Exposure | Dry heat |
    | Short term | up to +240 °C max. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.
2.9 Packaging.
    | Part A | 20,25 kg |
    | Part B | 4,75 kg |
    | Refer to current price list for packaging variations |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality. Refer to Sikalastic®-851 or Sikalastic®-8800 Product Data Sheets
3.3 Substrate preparation.
    - Apply Sikalastic®-8902 within the indicated overcoating time of the applied waterproofing membrane. No further substrate preparation is necessary.
    - If the overcoating time of the applied waterproofing membrane is exceeded, the surface must be prepared mechanically by a light grinding and application of the Sikalastic®-810 adhesion promoter.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 81:19 by weight
    - Consumption: ~0,75 kg/m²
    - Layer thickness: ~0,5 mm
    - Pot Life: ~25 minutes at +23 °C
4.3 Waiting time to overcoating. Minimum waiting time before paving asphalt overlay
    | Temperature | Minimum | Maximum |
    | +10 °C | 24 hours | 1 week |
    | +20 °C | 16 hours | 1 week |
    | +30 °C | 12 hours | 1 week |
4.4 Mixing. Stir part A for 3 minutes using a low speed single paddle electric stirrer (300–400 r/min). Add all of part B to part A and mix continuously until a uniform consistency has been achieved. To ensure thorough mixing pour materials into a clean container and mix again for at least 1,0 minute. Over mixing must be avoided to minimise air entrainment. During the final mixing stage, scrape down the sides and bottom of the mixing container with a flat or straight edge trowel at least once to ensure complete mixing. Mix full units only. Mixing time for A+B = 4,0 minutes.
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened/cured material can only be mechanically removed.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Sikalastic®-8902 is not UV resistant and changes colour under UV exposure. This has no influence on the function and performance of the coating if the exposure is a maximum of 4 weeks.
    - If the paving asphalt cannot take place within 3 days, the entire surface must be covered using suitable protective measures to prevent dirt and moisture contamination in addition to preventing mechanical damage of the pellets due to construction traffic.
    - Sikalastic®-8902 is not a trafficable surface, asphalt supply trucks and asphalt pavers must be the only vehicles to pass over the applied unprotected surface.
    - Exceeding the recommended thickness of the tack coat may lead to higher consumption.
    - Exceeding the recommended thickness may lead to limited performance of the broadcast Sikalastic®-827 HT pellets.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.3 Relative air humidity. < 80 %
5.4 Dew point. Substrate temperature must be min +3 °C above dew point, beware of condensation
5.5 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +50 °C max.
5.6 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.6):
    - If the paving asphalt cannot take place within 3 days, the entire surface must be covered using suitable protective measures to prevent dirt and moisture contamination in addition to preventing mechanical damage of the pellets due to construction traffic.
5.7 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Tensile strength: >10 N/m² (DIN 53504)
5.8 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.9 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-8902, April 2023, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sikalastic-8902.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
